environment.description: EKS pod in us-east-1 VPC with default S3 VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) configured with full-access policy. Pod service account has IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::shared-config-artifacts-prod/*. No network policy restricting pod-to-pod traffic. gRPC port 50051 exposed via ClusterIP service accessible from any namespace.
